fts_build loops readdir until NULL without resetting/checking errno around end and ignores closedir result. A directory-stream error can therefore be treated as empty or partially enumerated directory rather than explicit error, even if final caller checks errno later. Source-level finding, not injected runtime failure.

Directory entries are materialized in a linked list before return; optional sorting allocates full pointer array and falls back to filesystem order on allocation failure. No explicit entry-memory or cancellation budget in this module.

Cycle detection scans ancestors by device/inode. FTS_SKIP and XDEV yield postorder visits without enumerating children; this is intentional pruning that callers must distinguish from exhaustive traversal.
